purpose: Separate trusted observation horizon provenance from useful-work evidence endpoints so valid trailing gaps remain measurable without allowing caller-invented, author-controlled, or run-attempt-ambiguous horizons.
fail_closed: Reject promotion beyond the durable trusted horizon. Git commit timestamps cannot establish the boundary. Actions provenance MUST bind both run id and run attempt, and validation MUST fetch the attempt-specific endpoint so a later re-run of the same run id cannot substitute a different attempt. The attempt-specific endpoint is authoritative for attempt identity and observed API state; policy MUST NOT claim GitHub contractually guarantees post-completion immutability of its updated_at field unless such a guarantee is separately established.
